name: Human Anatomy & Histology
summary: The structure of the human body, from tissues seen under the microscope to the organ systems, organised by body region and system.

topics.name: Anatomical terminology, planes, regions and body cavities
Histology: epithelial, connective, muscle and nervous tissue
The skeletal system: bone tissue, the axial and appendicular skeleton
Joints: types, structure and range of motion
The muscular system: major muscle groups, origins, insertions and actions
Nervous system anatomy: brain, spinal cord and peripheral nerves
Special sense organs: eye and ear
Cardiovascular anatomy: heart, arteries, veins and capillary beds
Surface anatomy and medical imaging views (X-ray, CT, MRI)
